body.en:
The hammam is a steam bath and an old tradition in Morocco. Every neighbourhood has one, and many riads and spas offer a more private version for visitors.

## What happens inside

You relax in a warm steam room, then an attendant washes you with black soap and scrubs your skin with a rough glove called a kessa. At the end you rinse with warm water and rest with a mint tea.

## What to bring

- A swimsuit or underwear
- A towel and sandals
- A change of clothes

> Public hammams have separate times or rooms for men and women.

## Where to try it

In Marrakech and Fes you can choose a public hammam for the local experience, or a spa hammam for more comfort. [Contact us](contact.html) and we will add it to your trip.
